brief:
Israeli forces killed eight Palestinians in Gaza on Thursday, Middle East Eye reported, as authorities issued fresh expulsion orders across several areas. The deaths occurred amid a broader pattern of displacement affecting multiple neighborhoods in the territory.

Families in the affected zones were forced to abandon their homes following the military orders, compounding a humanitarian crisis already marked by widespread displacement and casualties throughout the Gaza Strip.
dek: Israel kills eight in Gaza as families forced to flee homes Israeli forces killed eight Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Thursday as they issued fresh expulsion orders in several areas, according to local reports.
title: Israeli forces kill eight Palestinians as Gaza families flee homes
